title: 钢价高位引进口回流，富国银行警示上行空间有限
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I know you just came back from the biggest steel gathering conference in Atlanta, and just looking some of your research from it, it feels like there is this continued optimism
segments.zh: 我知道你刚从亚特兰大最大的钢铁会议回来，从你的研究来看，感觉市场持续乐观。

segments.en: of elevated prices. You're a bit more cautious. Why?
segments.zh: 对价格高位持乐观态度，但你更谨慎，为什么？

segments.en: Sure, I think that you've come off of a really strong year in the last 12 months or so, the stocks have doubled, in many cases, and you had steel prices explode.
segments.zh: 过去12个月表现强劲，许多权益资产翻倍，钢价飙升。

segments.en: Much of that was due to the 50% tariffs that were put in place a little over a year ago.
segments.zh: 这主要归因于一年多前实施的50%关税。

segments.en: They affected the market on a lag. And demand was a little better than expected as well, so I think there is a snowball effect of enthusiasm, but it's really hard to replicate that kind of year after what we've come
segments.zh: 关税影响滞后，需求也好于预期，所以有乐观情绪滚雪球，但很难复制那样的年份。

segments.en: off of. And at these prices, we're talking around $1,200 for hot road coil in the US, it's high enough to attract imports even with a 50% tariff.
segments.zh: 目前美国热轧卷价格约1200美元，即使有50%关税，也足以吸引进口。

segments.en: So we think that it's really hard to argue for much more upside from these prices.
segments.zh: 因此我们认为价格很难有更多上行空间。

segments.en: The question is, can we hold on to these high prices in light of some of the seasonality, some of the imports, and more capacity coming on domestically?
segments.zh: 问题是，考虑到季节性、进口和国内新增产能，能否维持高价？

segments.en: And indeed, Prime Minister Mark Carney has pledged to support, to offer support in the face of these tariffs.
segments.zh: 总理卡尼承诺在关税面前提供支持。

segments.en: Do you see that causing any impact to pricing at all?
segments.zh: 你认为这会对价格产生影响吗？

segments.en: So if you're referring to Canada putting on its own tariffs against the US, it's pretty irrelevant.
segments.zh: 所以如果你指的是加拿大对美国加征自己的关税，那其实无关紧要。

segments.en: It's very much for show, as many of these kind of announcements are.
segments.zh: 这很大程度上是作秀，很多这类声明都是如此。

segments.en: So Canada has been a net exporter to the US.
segments.zh: 加拿大一直是美国的净出口国。
